newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: No reason to worry about Lisbon bourse surge - Min.
newsitem.headline: No reason to worry about Lisbon bourse surge - Min.

text.p: Portuguese Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco said he saw no reason to worry about the recent strong rise of Lisbon share prices.

"I don't think there are reasons to worry. This very strong rise is partly speculative, but partly also based on the real value of stocks," Sousa Franco told Reuters Financial Television (RFTV) in an interview at a conference in Frankfurt.
Lisbon share prices have risen by some 40 percent so far this year.
